Joshi, J.U. and Bolech, M. (2022). Decarbonisation options for the Dutch onshore gas and oil industry. MIDDEN report, PBL publication number 4958, TNO project nr. 060.47868 / TNO 2022 P10825. The Hague: PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency and TNO Energy Transition. Dated 11 October 2022.

Page numbers are the printed page numbers, which equal PDF page numbers. The report gives few per-unit technology parameters: it is mostly a sector emissions inventory plus option descriptions. Loaded: gas-turbine compressor efficiency assumption (33%) and per-kWh-output CO2/CH4; electric compressor drive efficiency (99% x 95%), unit sizes (Groningen GLT 23 MW, Wijngaarden 10 MW) and costs (GLT first cluster US$70m2018; EPA 2011 four 1.3 MW US$9.4m2018, O&M 10%); mobile recompression unit (225 kW, ~1% fuel per gas recovered, EUR2018 2m first-unit capex, O&M 10%); gas receiving station preheating: conventional water-bath outlet temperature, vortex tube + ground heat exchanger (80-88% gas saving), flat-plate solar (8-12%, US$2018 153k), evacuated-tube solar + MTG-550 turboexpander (Tables 7-8); cryogenic ASU electricity for nitrogen (0.16-0.30 and 0.35-0.55 kWh/m3). Mobile flaring, LDAR and zero-emission valves get description rows only (paybacks in _measures). Not loaded (in _other-values): facility/sector emissions and NG use (Tables 1, 2, 4), grid-dependent electric-compressor savings, Schoonebeek CHP plant data (no output), blue-hydrogen footprint assumptions, hydrogen network costs. Not extracted: Figures 1-21 (charts), Appendix 1 equations, Table 3/5/10 (qualitative or sector totals). No dehydration, gas treating, CCS or line-heater-at-wellsite numbers: the report refers to Tamez & Dellaert (2020) for those. Most cost and performance numbers are reprinted from foreign case studies (EPA 2011 USA, Ghezelbash 2016 Iran, Farzaneh-Gord Iran, Barone 2019 Italy).

(1) EPA cost printed as 'US $9.4 million2018 in 2011' - price year 2018 taken as labelled. (2) Farzaneh-Gord et al. cited as 2021 in the text but 2014 in the figure captions and reference list. (3) Table 11 prints the methane column as 'gCH2/MJNG'. (4) Tables 1-2 report ETS emissions as 'kilotonnes CO2 eq' though ETS data exclude methane. (5) Solar irradiation printed as 'kWh/m2hr' (should be per year). (6) LDAR text says '27 CO2, eq' (unit missing; Table 10 says kt). (7) NG heating value differs: LHV 31.65 MJ/Nm3 (s.2.3.1, L-gas) vs 35.17 MJ/Nm3 (App. 2). (8) The 0.6 kg/kWh output factor is 0.20/0.33 with an assumed, not measured, 33% efficiency.
